description: California Snow Data is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. The California Snow Data page contains resources from the California Data Exchange Center (CDEC) in open and machine readable format. These resources include snow sensor and snow course metadata and measurements and snow water content data. Snow courses are typically sampled manually around the beginning of the month during the February through May period. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Water Resources. Its tags are CDEC, California Cooperative Snow Survey, SWC, SWE, Snow Courses. It offers 14 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, WEB APPLICATION. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
